timeline.title: Rotaract District Information System
timeline.body: Building the reporting, membership and performance-assessment platform for a district of 68 clubs, replacing a system with no scoring engine and serious data-protection gaps.

timeline.title: Fraine Supermarket app
timeline.body: Full redesign and rebuild of a supermarket's mobile application across five branches, handling pickup and delivery from one codebase.

timeline.title: R&D Software Developer
timeline.body: Cetus Central, an enterprise IoT platform for industrial energy. Designed a microservices architecture for real-time ingestion across distributed systems, built Kafka, Redis and PostgreSQL pipelines reaching sub-millisecond state reads, and integrated grid protocols including MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus and IEC 61850. Delivered six core modules covering power quality, fault outage, energy integrity, topology twin, communication and metering data.

timeline.title: System Architect & Planner
timeline.body: Architected a smart water dispenser system combining ESP32 devices, RFID authentication and mobile money. Modelled the transaction-heavy schema, designed the API layer between devices, dashboards and mobile, and planned a fault-tolerant offline-first edge approach.

timeline.title: Immediate Past President
timeline.body: Supporting incoming leadership without running the club. A role that is mostly about restraint.

timeline.title: Appointed incoming PIME Chair
timeline.body: Planning, Implementation, Monitoring and Evaluation for a district of 68 clubs. Term begins July 2027.

timeline.title: President
timeline.body: Led the club through a full Rotary year: projects, fundraising, membership growth and the weekly discipline of showing up. Handed over with the structures in better shape than I found them.

timeline.title: LearnEasy
timeline.body: Peer learning platform on the MERN stack with role-based access for students, facilitators and admins, Redis caching, Socket.IO real-time communication, and containerised deployment on Docker and Kubernetes.

timeline.title: Graduated, Makerere University
timeline.body: Bachelor of Information Systems and Technology, Systems Development.

timeline.title: Software Developer Intern
timeline.body: Built the SUDI marketplace on the PERN stack: REST APIs for users, listings, payments and chat, OAuth2 and JWT across every endpoint, WebSocket messaging, caching and performance tuning. Also built KauntaBook, an SME financial platform on serverless Firebase Functions handling transactions, invoicing and reporting.

timeline.title: IT Intern
timeline.body: Contributed to system design and database normalisation for enterprise systems, built components of a queue management system in Java and Spring Boot, managed Active Directory and network infrastructure, and provided IT support.

timeline.title: Member, buddy group leader, board
timeline.body: Worked up through the club rather than into it. Board responsibility is where I learned that attendance records, dues tracking and reporting were quietly eating everyone's time.

timeline.title: Founded the Rotaract Club of Kitante
timeline.body: Part of the founding group that formed the club from nothing. We recruited members, built the meeting rhythm, and set up the structures that let it survive its first year.

timeline.title: Began at Makerere University
timeline.body: Information Systems and Technology, specialising in systems development.
